summary: Removed the standalone 'index tracking-error <schemeId>' command entirely.
reason: Indexes themselves are not traded and have no tracking error; tracking error is a fund/ETF-level concept, and the same officially disclosed ratio is already surfaced per-fund via fund get, index tracking, and index cheapest-tracker. The rolling-series command was also redundant with the live-dogfood harness's fixture picker feeding it an invalid schemeId (an index category label rather than a fund ID), which was masking the conceptual mismatch.
validated_outcome: go build, go test ./..., and a full live dogfood run (109 tests) all pass cleanly after removal with zero skips attributable to this command.
